notes_global: Languages permitted on the official Class C (passenger / non-CDL) WRITTEN KNOWLEDGE TEST as administered by the state DMV / DPS / DOT / SOS / equivalent. Manual translations are NOT included unless they coincide with what's offered on the test. CDL knowledge tests are typically more restrictive (English-only or English+Spanish) and out of scope here. ISO 639-1 codes used where available, with ISO 639-3 fallbacks for languages without a 639-1 code (e.g. hmn=Hmong, cv=Cape Verdean Creole as kea, fil=Filipino/Tagalog). Anchors verified during compilation: TX, WY, CA, NY, FL, MA, MO, AL, VT. Florida went English-only Feb 6, 2026.

language_codes_used.asl: American Sign Language (not a spoken language; included where DMV offers ASL video test)

al.name: Alabama
al.notes: Per the November 2024 ALEA Driver License Manual, the written exam is offered in English, Arabic, Chinese, Farsi, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Spanish, Thai, and Vietnamese (12 languages — Greek was on the 2017 list but not on the 2024 manual's published list). Road skills test is English only; interpreter available on request for skills.

ak.name: Alaska
ak.notes: Alaska DMV publishes only an English driver's manual and administers the knowledge test in English only. No official multi-language test offering listed on dmv.alaska.gov. Interpreter policy not explicitly published.

az.name: Arizona
az.notes: Per AZ MVD (azdot.gov), written knowledge test offered in 11 languages. Automated, printed, and audio formats available. Verbal test available by appointment if applicant cannot read or test in target language is unavailable.

ar.name: Arkansas
ar.notes: Arkansas State Police administers the test. Official DFA/ASP site does not publish a language list, but test is administered in English and Spanish; interpreters generally accommodated. Per 2016 USEnglish fact sheet, only EN+ES.

ca.name: California
ca.notes: CA DMV says the online knowledge test is offered in 35 languages (as of 2024-2025). DMV does NOT publish a single enumerated list on dmv.ca.gov; the 7-language Dymally-Alatorre reduction proposed in 2021 (EN, ES, Armenian, Chinese, Hindi, Punjabi, Vietnamese) did NOT take effect — the broader list is still in use. List here is the historical 32-language DMV list plus updates; some languages may not match the current exact 35. Verify directly before relying.

co.name: Colorado
co.notes: CO DMV: test offered in English and Spanish only, both in-office and via @Home option. Audio (read-aloud) available in EN/ES. For other languages, applicant must bring own translator; ASL interpreter provided by DMV.

ct.name: Connecticut
ct.notes: CT DMV digital test available in 11 languages per Customer Accommodations page. 2023 legislature mandated expansion to 26+ languages; rollout ongoing. Drive-Only Program test in EN, ES, PL, FR, IT, PT, ZH (Mandarin), AR, RU. Foreign dictionary allowed if language not offered.

de.name: Delaware
de.notes: DE DMV officially publishes manuals in EN/ES. Historical 5-language test per 2016 USEnglish fact sheet (EN, ES, HT, KO, ZH). The official site does not publish a current test-language list; verify locally. Manual updated July 2025.

dc.name: District of Columbia
dc.notes: DC DMV knowledge test in 24 languages (as of Dec 2025 expansion; was 15). Languages per dmv.dc.gov/service/knowledge-test: English, Amharic, Arabic, Cantonese, Danish, Dutch, Farsi, Finnish, French, German, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin (Chinese), Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Tagalog, Thai, Turkish, Vietnamese. (Cantonese+Mandarin collapsed to zh.) Audio-assisted exam available; language line service available. CDL is English only.

fl.name: Florida
fl.notes: Effective Feb 6, 2026: FLHSMV administers all driver license knowledge and skills exams in ENGLISH ONLY (including oral). Translation services prohibited; printed exams in other languages removed. Previously offered EN, ES, HT, RU, ZH, AR, PT, VI, FR — all discontinued.

ga.name: Georgia
ga.notes: Georgia DDS Non-Commercial knowledge exam (Road Rules + Road Signs) offered in 26 languages per dds.georgia.gov/list-languages: English, Albanian, Amharic, Arabic, Burmese, Chinese, Dari (collapsed to fa), Farsi, French, German, Haitian Creole, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Pashto, Portuguese (Brazil), Rohingya, Russian, Spanish, Swahili, Turkish, Urdu, Vietnamese, Wolof, Yoruba. Road skills test is English only.

hi.name: Hawaii
hi.notes: Hawaii written test offered in 14 languages per HDOT (incl. Hawaiian, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese — both collapsed to zh; Chuukese, Ilocano, Marshallese, Samoan, Tagalog, Tongan, Vietnamese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish). Online Home Driving Knowledge Test available statewide (Dec 2024). Free interpreter service via (808) 831-7921 for other languages.

id.name: Idaho
id.notes: Idaho Transportation Department: knowledge test offered in multiple languages including those above (per 2016 USEnglish + ITD confirmation). Translator allowed if language not offered OR after 3 failed attempts in offered language. ASL accommodated.

il.name: Illinois
il.notes: IL SOS administers driver test in 5 languages per long-standing policy. CDL knowledge test is English only, no interpreter.

in.name: Indiana
in.notes: IN BMV: per 2016 USEnglish fact sheet, 12 languages including English, Arabic, Burmese, Chin (collapsed; no 639-1), German, Japanese, Korean, Punjabi, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Vietnamese. BMV does not publish current enumerated list online.

ia.name: Iowa
ia.notes: Iowa DOT offers test with written and audio translations in 21 languages per iowadot.gov Immigrant & Refugee Process page. Interpreter services available for dialects not on the list (by appointment).

ks.name: Kansas
ks.notes: Kansas Dept of Revenue / Division of Vehicles: online test (KnowTo Drive) in English and Spanish only. In-office tests also English/Spanish primarily; interpreter accommodation possible.

ky.name: Kentucky
ky.notes: Kentucky State Police administers; written permit test in ~21 languages per KSP and university advising sources (some sites list up to 26 including Burmese, Dari, Pashto, Hindi, Kinyarwanda, Swahili). Oral test available; ASL on request. Signs section requires English understanding regardless.

la.name: Louisiana
la.notes: Louisiana OMV automated knowledge test in English, French, Spanish (per LA DPS OMV procedures doc). State law requires OMV to make provisions for non-English testing; applicants may bring their own translator for non-CDL written test. Interpreters prohibited for CDL.

me.name: Maine
me.notes: Maine BMV: digital system supports several languages (per 2016 list: EN, ES, FR, AR, SO). BMV provides FREE professional interpreter service (effective Feb 2026) for languages not in system; scheduling may take 4+ weeks. Audio format available.

md.name: Maryland
md.notes: Maryland MVA noncommercial Class C knowledge test in 17 languages (incl. ASL) per mva.maryland.gov. 2024 expansion added 9 languages. Spoken interpreter allowed for non-commercial, but only after 5 failed attempts in an offered language. CDL only in EN/ES.

ma.name: Massachusetts
ma.notes: MA RMV Class D/M learner's permit exam offered in 37 languages per mass.gov — the most of any US state. 2023 expansion added Albanian, Cape Verdean Creole, Hungarian, Kiswahili, Pashto, Turkish, Ukrainian. ASL only at Service Center. Audio assist available in all offered languages. CDL only in EN/ES/PT.

mi.name: Michigan
mi.notes: MI Secretary of State written test offered at all SOS offices in multiple languages with audio. Core list per ProEnglish + michigan.gov language services: ~17 languages. Some sources show 30+ via interpreter program. One-time interpreter approval available for any language.

mn.name: Minnesota
mn.notes: MN DPS / DVS offers written test in English, Spanish, Somali, Hmong, Vietnamese, Russian, Karen, and ASL. Online test only in EN/ES. Group oral tests available at select stations. For other languages, applicant must provide own interpreter.

ms.name: Mississippi
ms.notes: Mississippi DPS Driver Service Bureau does not publish a multi-language list on dps.ms.gov. Per ProEnglish (more recent) only EN+ES; per 2016 USEnglish list, 10 languages were once offered (incl. JA). Conservative current assumption: EN+ES. Verify.

mo.name: Missouri
mo.notes: Missouri State Highway Patrol Driver Examination administers Class F written test in 20 languages (per MSHP Modernized Testing System / FUSION upgrade), including a new ASL video version (collab with MO Commission for the Deaf). Specific list of 20 not enumerated online; this includes the historical 12 (EN, ES, BS, ZH, FR, DE, EL, IT, JA, KO, RU, VI) plus ASL and 7 more. Audio version of Driver Guide on YouTube. CDL is English only per RSMo 302.720.

mt.name: Montana
mt.notes: Per 2016 USEnglish fact sheet, MT MVD offers test in 4 languages. No newer enumerated official list found.

ne.name: Nebraska
ne.notes: Nebraska DMV: written test in English, Spanish, and ASL (video, statewide since Dec 2020). Manual in EN/ES with audio. Other languages by interpreter accommodation.

nv.name: Nevada
nv.notes: Nevada DMV: only EN and ES on touch-screen computers and online (KnowToDrive). For any other language, applicant must use a DMV-APPROVED interpreter (state maintains list).

nh.name: New Hampshire
nh.notes: NH DMV knowledge tests in 8 options: English, French, Spanish, Arabic, Mandarin (zh), Portuguese, Farsi, and ASL. Audio feature via headphones for any test. Interpreters for other languages permitted only at Concord DMV. 2024: 80+ language translation devices added for in-person services.

nj.name: New Jersey
nj.notes: NJ MVC: written knowledge test in 13 languages (EN, AR, ZH-Mandarin, FR, ES, KO, PL, PT, RU, JA, HI, SQ, TR). Oral test only EN/ES. For other languages, MVC provides and pays for an interpreter (4-6 week wait). CDL EN/ES; HazMat EN only. Driver Manual in EN, ES, TL, ZH.

nm.name: New Mexico
nm.notes: NM MVD non-commercial knowledge exam in 8 languages per mvd.newmexico.gov: English, Spanish, Tagalog, Italian, German, French, Vietnamese, Chinese. State explicitly states no plans to add more.

ny.name: New York
ny.notes: NY DMV: Class D permit test in 20 languages per dmv.ny.gov: English, Albanian, Arabic, Bengali, Bosnian, Chinese, French, Greek, Haitian Creole, Hebrew, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Nepali, Polish, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, Urdu, Yiddish. OKTA online test (for students) in EN/ES only. CDL manual in EN, ES, ZH, RU.

nc.name: North Carolina
nc.notes: NCDMV offers interpreter services and ASL on request; audio tests available. Official site does not enumerate languages but per 2016 USEnglish list and ProEnglish, 10 languages offered. Verify with NCDMV (919) 715-7000.

nd.name: North Dakota
nd.notes: NDDOT online driver knowledge test in 14 languages via KnowTo Drive: EN, ES, AR, ZH, FR, NE, RU, Serbo-Croatian, SO, SW, TR, VI, plus Dari (collapsed to fa) and Pashto (recent additions).

oh.name: Ohio
oh.notes: Ohio BMV knowledge test in 9 languages (text + audio): Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Haitian Creole, Japanese, Russian, Somali, Spanish. For other languages, applicant must schedule proctored test with own interpreter. Online testing available.

ok.name: Oklahoma
ok.notes: OK DPS does not publish a multi-language test list. 2016 USEnglish fact sheet shows English only; ProEnglish lists EN+ES. Conservative: EN+ES. Test now also offered through CareerTech centers.

or.name: Oregon
or.notes: OR DMV Class C knowledge test in 8 languages (per oregon.gov): English, Spanish, Arabic, Chinese (Simplified Mandarin), Japanese, Korean, Russian, Vietnamese. Audio version reads questions aloud. Available online and in-office.

pa.name: Pennsylvania
pa.notes: PennDOT non-commercial knowledge test in 30 languages per pa.gov: Albanian, Amharic, Arabic, Bosnian, Burmese, Cambodian (km), Dari (fa), English, Farsi, French, Greek, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin (zh), Mandinka, Nepali, Pashto, Polish, Portuguese, Punjabi, Russian, Somali, Spanish, Swahili, Turkish, Ukrainian, Urdu, Vietnamese. Written and audio at all Driver License Centers. ASL interpreter via LEP request (7-day notice).

ri.name: Rhode Island
ri.notes: RI DMV computerized knowledge exam in English, Spanish, Portuguese (only). Applicants may REQUEST printed exams in other foreign languages (scheduled in advance, at Cranston DMV). Historical 7-17 language lists exist but only EN/ES/PT are computerized.

sc.name: South Carolina
sc.notes: Per 2016 USEnglish fact sheet, SC DMV offers test in 4 languages (EN, ES, FR, DE). No updated enumerated list found on scdmvonline.com.

sd.name: South Dakota
sd.notes: SD DPS publishes Driver License application form in EN/ES and motorcycle manual in EN/ES. 2016 USEnglish list: English only. More recent third-party sources cite EN+ES. Conservative: EN+ES.

tn.name: Tennessee
tn.notes: TN Dept of Safety online knowledge test in EN/ES (for teens). Per 2016 USEnglish fact sheet, in-person test offered in EN, ES, JA, KO. Verify in-person availability locally.

tx.name: Texas
tx.notes: Texas DPS administers driver license knowledge test in ENGLISH OR SPANISH ONLY. Translators may help with communication BEFORE and AFTER the test, but not during. Applicants must understand English road signs. CDL also EN/ES only; interpreters prohibited for CDL skills test. Despite 3rd-party claims of VI/HI/ZH, official DPS confirms EN+ES only.

ut.name: Utah
ut.notes: Utah Driver License Division: written test in 14 languages per dld.utah.gov (some audio+text, some text-only). Includes Dari (text), Swahili, Somali, Tongan, Ukrainian. For other languages, applicant may use a division-approved interpreter. ASL accommodated.

vt.name: Vermont
vt.notes: Vermont DMV Learner's Permit exam in 15 languages per dmv.vermont.gov: English, Arabic, Bosnian/Serbian/Croatian (collapsed bs), Burmese, Dari (fa), French, Kirundi, Mandarin Chinese, Nepali, Pashto, Russian, Somali, Spanish, Swahili, Ukrainian. Test is online (20 questions, 16 to pass).

va.name: Virginia
va.notes: Virginia DMV knowledge exam in many languages per dmv.virginia.gov/licenses-ids/exams/know-lang: English, ASL, Amharic, Arabic, Chinese/Mandarin (both Simplified and Traditional collapsed to zh), Dari (fa), Farsi, French, German, Haitian Creole, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Kurdish, Mongolian, Nepali, Pashto, Punjabi, Russian, Spanish, Thai, Twi, Turkish (~22-24 total). Audio version available. TRANSLATORS NOT ALLOWED for tests in offered languages. CDL HazMat is EN only.

wa.name: Washington
wa.notes: WA DOL knowledge test in 12 listed options (Traditional + Simplified Chinese collapsed to zh): English, Spanish, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Russian, Vietnamese, Japanese, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Punjabi, Tagalog, Ukrainian. Availability may vary by training school / testing location.

wv.name: West Virginia
wv.notes: WV DMV: 2016 USEnglish list cited EN, JA, ES. Official current dmv.wv.gov pages do not enumerate languages, but practical offering is English (+ Spanish online with audio). Sign language interpreter / translator available on request. Conservative: EN+ES; JA legacy unverified currently.

wi.name: Wisconsin
wi.notes: WI DOT in-person Class D knowledge and signs tests offered in 11 options per wisconsindot.gov: English, ASL, Burmese, Chinese, Croatian, Hmong, Polish, Russian, Serbian, Somali, Spanish. Audio assist available. Online test (KnowTo Drive, age 17 and under) only in EN/ES. CDL/HazMat: English only; translator prohibited.

wy.name: Wyoming
wy.notes: Wyoming DOT: tests given in English only; all manuals in English only. Interpreter allowed for non-commercial written test (applicant-provided, must be 18+, not a relative, must sign Interpreter's Oath, may not help answer questions). Audio option available via phone system or simultaneously at testing station. CDL English only.
